content:
A T-Mobile outage last week left many iPhone users across the US without service for several hours, and Redditors are now reporting that they’ve been able to obtain compensation ranging from $10 to $80 …

The outage appears to have been a sizable one, impacting almost have a million people.

It was around seven hours before the carrier said service had been fully restored for all customers.

T-Mobile apologised, but hasn’t proactively offered any compensation to those affected. Instead, customers are saying that they had to contact the company to ask for it, as CNET reports.

This approach does seem regrettably common these days: you are only compensated if you actively demand it. If you succeed in achieving a credit from T-Mobile, please share the details in the comments to assist others.
